Carefully depict 고조선·여러 나라 Korea of this period: period-appropriate architecture, clothing and tools. No readable text, letters, captions, logos or watermarks. No graphic violence or blood. A sheer flat-topped cliff fortress above a river bend, stone walls along its rim and a steep stair cut into the rock; below, a valley of thatched houses and small fields, riders with iron spears returning along the water.
basis: 졸본이 고구려 첫 도성이고 환런현에 오녀산성이 있다는 서술(한국민족문화대백과사전 졸본·오녀산성)
caveats: 성벽과 마을 모습은 고증 복원이 아니라 표현이다.
